sections.heading: Tomorrowind
sections.text: Found a House Hlaalu colony anywhere in Morrowind. Give your settlers jobs, mine, farm, smelt and trade, and place every building wherever you like.
sections.note: Free. Needs your own Morrowind and OpenMW 0.52 or later.

sections.heading: See it in motion
sections.text: The 0.2 trailer: caravans at the market, rope bridges between roofs, a house sliding to a new spot, and settlers at home.

sections.heading: A colony that runs itself, but needs a leader
sections.intro: Press K, choose a spot and a storehouse goes up. Three settlers walk in. From there it's up to you.

items.title: Settlers with jobs
items.text: Woodcutters, farmers, miners, smelters, builders, traders and guards. Each is a unique Dunmer with a name, a face and their own hours.

items.title: Build anywhere
items.text: Place houses, farms and workshops wherever you stand. On slopes they get timber pilings, driven in one by one.

items.title: Watch it go up
items.text: Materials pile up beside the scaffold, then the building rises out of the ground.

items.title: Trade with caravans
items.text: Run a market stall. Caravans come by every two days to buy your surplus and sell you what you're short of.

items.title: Homes you can walk into
items.text: Furnish rooms with beds, rugs, candles and shrines. At night you'll find your settlers asleep inside.

items.title: It keeps going while you're away
items.text: Go adventuring. The colony carries on, and you get a summary when you come back.

sections.heading: Install
sections.requirements: You need your own copy of **Morrowind** and [OpenMW](https://openmw.org) **0.52 or later**, already set up to run Morrowind.

steps.title: Download the zip
steps.body: Use the download button on this page. You get `tomorrowind-vX.Y.Z.zip`.

steps.title: Unzip it somewhere it can stay
steps.body: You get a folder called `tomorrowind`. OpenMW loads the mod from there, so don't move or delete it afterwards.

steps.title: Add the folder in the OpenMW launcher
steps.body: Open **Data Files**, go to **Data Directories** and add the `tomorrowind` folder: the one with the two `Tomorrowind.*` files directly in it.

steps.title: Tick both content files
steps.body: On the **Content Files** tab, enable `Tomorrowind.omwaddon` and `Tomorrowind.omwscripts`, below `Morrowind.esm`.

steps.title: Found your colony
steps.body: Load a save or start a new game, stand somewhere outdoors and flat, and press **K**.

sections.manual:
**Without the launcher**, add these lines to `openmw.cfg`, with your own path:

```
data="/path/to/tomorrowind"
content=Tomorrowind.omwaddon
content=Tomorrowind.omwscripts
```

**Updating:** quit the game, replace the `tomorrowind` folder with the new one, and keep both content files ticked. Back up a save you care about first.
